contract_vs_implementation_deviation.item: Sprint Contract acceptance criterion #5 specifies 'terraform destroy (prod), apply -auto-approve (prod), state rm/push = deny' but firewall implementation places all three in ASK_PATTERNS (ask, not deny).
contract_vs_implementation_deviation.rationale_in_code: hooks/pre-bash-firewall.sh inline comment + profiles/iac.md lines 28-29: command-line cannot reliably distinguish prod from nonprod env without parsing terraform workspace/var-file/backend config, so firewall stays env-blind (ask everywhere) and prod-deny is delegated to /plan-review + Plan gate (sdlc-style ExitPlanMode for critical tier).
contract_vs_implementation_deviation.assessment: Defensible layered control and internally consistent with iac.md, plan-review SKILL.md, and INV-8 ('plan 미확인 apply 금지', 'auto-approve 금지'). However, contract should be backfilled to reflect the actual two-layer model so future audits do not re-flag this as a regression. Treating this as 'security weakening' would be incorrect: ask + Plan gate is stricter than no-control, and INV-5 add-only is preserved.
contract_vs_implementation_deviation.action: Backfill Sprint Contract acceptance criterion #5 wording: 'destroy / apply -auto-approve / state rm-push = ask (Plan gate + /plan-review enforces prod). import/taint = ask.' Apply in next sprint or as a doc-only patch — does not block F20 pass.

missing_guard_for_INV-8_specific_semanti.item: invariant-guard.sh has no INV-8-specific check (e.g., 'profiles/*.md must contain a verification gate description', 'plan-review SKILL.md cannot be deleted').
missing_guard_for_INV-8_specific_semanti.assessment: INV-7's INVARIANTS.md >30% shrink guard + tests/profile.bats 'profiles/iac.md exists and describes plan/apply lifecycle' (file-presence + keyword assertion) act as a partial 2nd-line defense via pre-commit-gate. Strictly, an /improve loop could delete profiles/iac.md or rewrite skills/plan-review/SKILL.md to be vacuous, and the guard would not block at edit time. Pre-commit-gate would catch profile.bats failure, but only after commit attempt.
missing_guard_for_INV-8_specific_semanti.action: Consider adding to invariant-guard in a later sprint: deny removal of skills/plan-review/, profiles/iac.md, or significant shrink of those files. Not blocking for F20 because (a) F20 just introduced these, (b) tests provide the regression net, (c) /improve has not yet been pointed at iac assets.

profile_bypass_assessment.question: Does the profile mechanism open a path to bypass SDLC verification (e.g., 'set profile=iac to skip evaluator')?
profile_bypass_assessment.verdict: no — profile does not weaken SDLC verification
evidence: Only setup-claudemd.sh reads the profile key; it controls which CLAUDE.md section is injected. No other hook/agent branches on profile.
Evaluator agent text does not reference profile — its scoring rubric (5 dimensions, min-of-5, critical-tier auto-fail) and harness-config thresholds remain canonical regardless of profile value.
invariant-guard registration in hooks.json is profile-independent; INV-3/5/6/7 enforcement applies on every Edit/Write/MultiEdit.

INV-8 explicitly codifies the non-bypass principle: '프로파일 전환으로 검증을 우회할 수 없다 … sdlc 프로파일의 pass_threshold·security_thresholds·evaluator 독립성은 프로파일과 무관하게 불변'. The plan-review SKILL.md mirrors this with 'plan-review 게이트의 통과 기준을 임의로 낮추지 않는다 (add-only, INV-8)'.
Smoke confirmed: bogus / malformed profile → SDLC fallback, never silent-skip-all.
profile_bypass_assessment.residual_risk: An IaC project legitimately switches profile to iac and chooses to apply changes via plan-review instead of full SDLC. This is the *designed* trade-off, not a bypass: iac still has a gate (plan-review + Plan-gate-for-critical), the gate's pass criteria are add-only by INV-8, and sdlc thresholds are not touched. Misuse pattern 'I set profile=iac then refuse to run plan-review' is not addressable by a hook (no operator interception); the layered controls are documented constraints rather than enforced runtime gates.
